questions: How many junctions did you fabricate and measure in total, over how many cooldowns, and how many showed the high-field pockets? Table S1 and SI Sec. F (p. 33) give two of the four moiré junctions; could the main text say so where it reads "reproduced across multiple additional devices" (p. 3)?
Fig. S1a shows several MoRe contacts on one stack: were other junctions on the GH1 to GH4 stacks measured, and if so, why were they set aside? (GH3 and GH4 are explained by their length on p. 33.)
Which field and density ranges did you measure beyond those shown, in particular the hole-side minibands (n/ns < -1) at high field and fields between 6 T and the 8 T magnet limit?
What does the second-best high-field dataset look like: could you show dV/dI against I at the highest fields that Fig. 2a and Fig. 3e mark as superconducting (5 to 6 T), in GH1 and GH2?
How was the 3447 Ω series resistance (SI p. 19) determined, and how do the pockets in Fig. 2a and the 20 mS cutoff of Fig. S18 change if it is off by 1 to 2%?

How much of the bright 1/R region in Fig. 3e survives with a dc bias above Ic (as in Fig. S14) or above the leads' Tc, where normal-state Brown-Zak conductance would remain and supercurrent would not?

Could you reconstruct the supercurrent distribution, as in Fig. S9, from the high-field interference patterns of Fig. 2c and Fig. S11, to see whether the pockets carry current through the bulk or near the edges?
How did you choose n/ns ∼ 1.8 and the fields 2.5, 3.5, 4.3 and 4.5 T for the interference patterns, and how many pockets did you measure in total compared with the number shown?
